label: Diagram 1.3
caption: Diagram 1.3 | Minimum headroom
description: A section through a stair showing minimum headroom (see para 1.11). A 'Flight' runs down from a 'Landing' on the left to a 'Landing' on the right, with a dashed 'Pitch line' along the nosings. A ceiling or soffit runs above, sloping down over the flight. Three dimensions, each 'At least 2m', give the headroom: from the upper landing up to the ceiling above it, from the pitch line up to the soffit over the flight, and from the lower landing up to a dashed line marked 'Minimum headroom' under the structure on the right.
model_description:
This diagram, titled Diagram 1.3 Minimum headroom, depicts a side section profile of a staircase connecting two levels via a flight and landings. The drawing shows a flight of stairs between two landings. A dashed line, labelled 'Pitch line', runs parallel to the slope of the stairs. 

There are three vertical dimension lines indicating the required clearance. The first, on the left, shows a distance of 'At least 2m' from the upper 'Landing' to the 'Pitch line'. The second, in the middle, shows a distance of 'At least 2m' from the 'Pitch line' to the ceiling or structure above. The third, on the right, shows a distance of 'At least 2m' from the lower 'Landing' to the 'Pitch line'. A horizontal dashed line on the right is labelled 'Minimum headroom'. A note in the top left corner reads 'See para 1.11'.
